name: Harrison Sand
biography: Harrison is a software and application security specialist with experience in embedded devices and IoT. He has worked closely with penetration testing, incident response, embedded security, and vulnerability management. He has a passion for cybersecurity research and has had work featured in publications such as TechCrunch, PC Magazine, The Register, Ars Technica, Hackaday, Aftenposten, and NRK.
